description: Calculates the values of the tenant's active KPIs for a period: value, unit, format_type, previous_value, change and change_percentage (month-over-month change) and positive_trend_is_good per KPI.

kpi_ids.description: Optional list of KPI IDs to filter. Omit for all active KPIs.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

name: query_kpis
